name: leadgen-tool
description: Multi-tenant, AI-personalized lead-generation and growth platform: any company registers, gets an AI-synthesized ideal-customer/geo/outreach profile, then searches for prospects (Nairobi -> Kenya -> East Africa -> Africa -> Global), runs AI cold-calling + email campaigns with a self-improving scorer, and uses an AI sales assistant plus a content studio (pitches, ad copy, social plans, graphics, video-ad concepts) to sell itself.
